hold_reason: Refund for order 204 (11000 cents) was requested in this batch but is not in the refunds table. list_refunds shows only orders 201 (3873) and 203 (18687). W2 reported only these two as applied. No payouts recorded. Needs human review of the missing order 204 refund before any payouts proceed.

reply.thought: The handoff lists three requested refunds, but W2 reports only two as applied. Before recording any payout I need to check the refunds table directly, starting with list_refunds.

The refunds table has only orders 201 and 203. The batch requested a refund of 11000 cents for order 204, and it is missing from the table. The instructions say to hold rather than pay when a requested refund is absent, so I'm stopping the batch for review.
